Commentary.Commentary: One would probably feel the Windies have batted the Irish out of the game. There is no doubt that the Irish will go for it but they will need something spectacular. Can they pull it off? Stay tuned to find out.

Not a lot to write about the Irish bowling. Dockrell did bowl well but was unlucky, he looked the most threatening but despite that, he went for around 8 per over. The pacers were taken to the cleaners. However, McCarthy and Adair did have something to smile about as the former finished with a two-fer and the latter with a wicket to his name.

After being inserted, Campbell was nearly run out on the very first ball of the game but Ireland failed to hit the stumps then. After that, it was all about the two openers. They smashed the bowlers to all parts of the ground. Both not only managed to score tons but they ensured they scored daddy tons. They registered the highest opening stand of 365-runs in ODIs but the two perished in the same over itself. The runs then dried up but the total is still a huge one.

A power-packed batting performance by the Windies comes to an end! WOW! They though would feel a little disappointed that they haven't got to 400 but they will be extremely pleased with their overall effort.
